svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Azure Vending Machine governed workflow
svg.desc: Seven-step flow from a request in Microsoft Teams through deterministic validation, explicit confirmation, ServiceNow human approval, reviewed source-control change, the only Azure write scope in an Azure Verified Modules pipeline, and status returned to Teams. Rejected or failed requests return status without deployment.
svg.text: Conversational request, human governance, reviewed change, deterministic delivery
The agent gathers and validates intent but has no Azure write access
Human approval and source-control review are mandatory control gates
Only the deterministic AVM pipeline can write to Azure
Rejected or failed → return status, no deployment
Status and next steps returned to Teams
